utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yep, yep, drag in. Remember I told you, now, when you swing it, when you get out— oh, nope, nope, you don't want to throw the pole in the water. Oh no, you can do it now.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I couldn't do this the first time. Did you catch a fish?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I saw a fish under the water right by it!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Good, medium size. Don't you need worms?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: No, we're just practicing casting today. See, now, now you— now watch this. Now watch with my hand. You see now I push the button and I'm going to do it in slow motion and show you.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Grandpa, everything you do is in slow motion. We’ve been 'practicing' for twenty minutes, can we just actually fish?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: That’s a bit uncalled for. I’m taking the time to teach you right so you don't lose a finger or a pole. Patience is part of fishing, even if you think I'm too slow.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I didn't mean it like that, I'm just bored of the 'button' talk.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Well, the 'button talk' is how you catch things. Now, as I was saying, you don't have to throw it real hard, you just got to get it out here and then go like this. You can do that. It's all when you let go of the— and you have your practice aim at it and then you'll get good at it. There you go. Good shot. Oh wow. There you go. It cast it out. It just didn't get the one. But that takes a little bit of practice. It's like a timing thing. Here's what I do. I go like this. Okay, push it down, hold it back, and go 1, 2, 3. Just like that. See where it went?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: If you do that, you catch fish most times. When you bite. Where's your pole?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I can't walk because your fish broke. Oh, I lost a weight.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: That's crazy because that's the— 6 foot? That's a 25-foot. You can keep the weight just hanging down. Let me reel it up. Let go of that one.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Let go and then I can reel it up. Let go of this. This right here. Gotta let go of that. Get it. Okay, now you can push it down and hold it and then swing it. Just do it gentle. Wait a minute, wait a minute, it wrapped around here. See, when you get ready to do that, it'll wrap around there if you're not— if you don't have something on here to— let go of the button. Okay, see, then you can rail it up when it clicks. Then— okay, now just do it nice and easy. Press the button down when you're swinging it. You got to let the button go then when you get out the end of your swing. Now is it catching or something? Sometimes it gets wrapped around. It's hard to see.
